rounds.prompt:
Documentary photograph aesthetic, unretouched, fine film grain.

A reception desk seen from slightly above. A woman's hands enter from the right edge; one hand holds a plain grey telephone handset to her ear, the other hand's fingertip rests on the paper wall calendar's empty grid. The moment of the second call. Patient, tired, unposed.

FG: the calendar edge, slightly below centre. MG: the hands and the handset, occupying the right third. BG: a plain wall, softly defocused.

Light: cool morning daylight from a window on the right, soft; the left side of the desk falls into gentle shade.

Composition: rule of thirds. The handset and the hands fill the right third; the lower left quadrant is calm empty calendar cells, left clear for copy added later.

Angle: eye-level, slightly off axis, with comfortable margin around the subject on all sides.

Focus: hard focus on the fingertip on the grid. Set to 50mm, medium depth of field so the background stays readable during a slow dolly in.

Tone: Low Saturation Gray palette, muted grey-green and warm beige. Natural skin texture with visible pores, matte skin with no shine, believable proportions and natural hands.

The subject reads clearly against the background in tone and value.

Overall vibe: two calls to the parent, one unanswered.

The desk surface is bare and unmarked, the handset plain and unbranded, the calendar cells empty, every surface clean and free of lettering.

Documentary photograph aesthetic, unretouched, fine film grain.

A reception desk seen from slightly above, a tight tabletop shot. Only a woman's hands and forearms enter from the right edge: one hand lifts the plain grey handset of a desk phone a few centimetres off its cradle, the other hand's fingertip rests on the desk beside a pen. Her head and shoulders are above the top edge of the frame. The moment before the second call. Patient, tired, unposed.

FG: the pen, slightly below centre. MG: the hands and the desk phone, occupying the right third. BG: a plain wall and a shelf edge, softly defocused.

Light: cool daylight from a window on the right, soft; the left side of the desk falls into gentle shade.

Composition: rule of thirds. The phone and the hands fill the right third; the lower left quadrant is calm bare desk, left clear for copy added later.

Angle: high three-quarter, just above desk height, with comfortable margin around the subject on all sides.

Focus: hard focus on the fingers around the lifted handset. Set to 50mm, medium depth of field so the background stays readable during a slow dolly in.

Tone: Low Saturation Gray palette, muted grey-green and warm beige. Natural skin texture with visible pores, matte skin with no shine, believable proportions and natural hands.

The subject reads clearly against the background in tone and value.

Overall vibe: two calls to the parent, one unanswered.

The desk surface is bare and unmarked, the phone plain and unbranded with a blank keypad, every surface clean and free of lettering.
